sections.title: Do you speak …?
sections.content: Ask a friend with the *te* form: *Beszélsz magyarul?* (Do you speak Hungarian?) Answer by repeating the verb: *Igen, beszélek.* or *Nem, nem beszélek.* The answer can name the language again: *Nem, nem beszélek németül.* For another person use the *ő* form: *Anna beszél spanyolul.*

sections.title: Also, and both
sections.content: Put *is* (also) after the language: *Beszélsz angolul is?* (Do you speak English too?) Join two languages with *és*: *Angolul és magyarul beszélek.*

items.english: No, I do not speak German.

sections.content: Keep the person ending on the verb and the language ending on the language: *Beszélsz magyarul?* has *-sz* on the verb and *-ul* on the language, and each does its own job.
